description: Implementation of AeadBaseDecrypter class for AEAD decryption in QUIC protocol, including key management, nonce handling, and decryption logic.

classes.name: AeadBaseDecrypter
classes.description: Class providing AEAD decryption functionalities, including key setup, nonce management, and packet decryption.

methods.name: InitAndCall
methods.description: Initializes BoringSSL and retrieves the specified AEAD algorithm.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Sets the nonce prefix for IETF nonce construction.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector (IV) for Google QUIC.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Sets a preliminary key for key diversification.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Diversifies the preliminary key using a nonce.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Decrypts a packet given packet number, associated data, and ciphertext.

methods.name: GetKeySize
methods.description: Returns the size of the key.

methods.name: GetNoncePrefixSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the nonce prefix.

methods.name: GetIVSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IV.
